title: In Telerik UI for Blazor, versions v12.0.0 through 15.2.0, an improper input validation vulnerability exists, where…
description: An improper input validation vulnerability exists in Telerik UI for Blazor versions 12.0.0 through 15.2.0. This flaw affects the Grid, TreeList, and Gantt components, allowing their AI command filters to operate on any model property, bypassing the declared column allowlist.
